abandon_criterion.note: drop the route if the first 50 candidates are all drop or inconclusive at 300M trials

bar.note: largest g on the board at d=4; 2D-local candidates are compared on d and g within their cell

direction.expected_value: Either a submittable 2D-local code-calculus family with credible witnesses, or a documented closure of the 2D-local route that saves all future GPU spend on it.
direction.feasibility: Candidates and parents already exist from cc-greedy-2dlocal-v2; leader_audit.py pair runs both sides at matched depth, and verify/ris_gpu.py reaches 300M trials per side on A100/H20 nodes.
direction.hypothesis: The 2D-local code-calculus candidates that pass a 2M-trial deep pass are credible at 300M trials on matched seeds and pair depth, and the inflation seen in cc-greedy-2dlocal-v2 is a screening-depth artifact rather than a real distance loss.

novelty.against: the 2D-local frontier and the inflation result of fieldnotes/2026-11-12-code-calculus-v0p2-greedy-gated.md
novelty.claim: a credible 2D-local code-calculus candidate at d>=3 with a 300M-trial witness

direction.what_a_negative_would_teach: That the 2D-local code-calculus distance claims are inflated by construction, not merely under-verified, so the route should be closed rather than deepened.

campaign.name: Deep-verify 2D-local code-calculus candidates at GPU depth
campaign.notes: CPU enumerates and gates; GPU resolves matched-depth distance only. No candidate is submitted without a credible peer audit.
